summary: Configuration as code for AAP uses validated collections from Automation Hub: `infra.aap_utilities` (install, backup, restore, certificates), `infra.aap_configuration` (RBAC, projects, job templates, credentials; replaces `infra.controller_configuration`, `infra.ah_configuration` and `infra.eda_configuration` in 2.6) and `infra.ee_utilities` (build EEs, migrate from virtualenvs).
questions: Which collection manages AAP configuration as code?
Should I still use infra.controller_configuration with AAP 2.6?
How do I build execution environments as code?
